summary: Iteration 6 (frontend-only) verified. The .btn-navy secondary style was recolored to light periwinkle-blue via new tokens and applied uniformly to every 'Book a demo' / secondary button across all 16 pages. Computed styles, dark-hero legibility, navigation targets, and regression items (free-trial modal, pricing tabs, Monthly/Yearly toggle, BulkSigner estimator, responsive layout) all pass.

detailed_verifications.nav_demo_btn_all_pages: 16/16 pages -> computed bg=rgb(237,240,255), border-color=rgb(196,205,255), color=rgb(59,35,168). Exact match with spec.
detailed_verifications.dark_grey_secondary_buttons_remaining: None found on any of the 16 pages (no element with computed background rgb(44,47,54)).
detailed_verifications.dark_background_legibility: Verified via screenshots on index hero, pricing hero and industry hero/CTA. The light periwinkle background (#EDF0FF) combined with violet ink (#3B23A8) and violet border (#C4CDFF) gives a clear, readable pill on the dark violet backgrounds. Contrast between button text and button bg is strong; button-vs-hero-bg edge is also clearly discernible due to the border. Legibility PASS.
detailed_verifications.navigation_targets: nav-demo-btn click navigates to /contact.html#demo (confirmed). hero-demo-btn href = /contact.html#demo. Pricing product-specific CTAs still resolve to /contact.html?product=... (verified via data-testid inventory).
detailed_verifications.free_trial_modal: Three product cards present with correct external hrefs: esignature -> https://app.signulu.com/account/register, dms -> https://www.signuluone.com/Dms.html, bulksigner -> https://bulksigner.signuluone.com/#download. No <select> inside the open modal.
detailed_verifications.pricing_tabs: Three distinct panes present (pricing-pane-esignature / -dms / -bulksigner) with unique CTA IDs per plan.
detailed_verifications.monthly_yearly_toggle: esign-billing-switch toggles displayed price between $59.88 (yearly) and $9.99 (monthly). Confirmed both directions.
detailed_verifications.bulksigner_estimator: 3 -> Basic / ₹6,600. 7 -> Pro / ₹12,600. 25 -> Business / ₹37,500. 120 -> Enterprise / ₹1,20,000. Exact spec match.

critical_code_review_comments: Color change is implemented cleanly at the token level (--sg-secondary-soft / -hover / -border / -ink in tokens.css) and .btn-navy consumes them, so future palette tweaks stay a one-line change.
All previous btn-outline-light demo buttons on dark bands are now btn-navy, so the secondary style is truly uniform — no hidden variants left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Bootstrap site served by python http.server on :3000, exposed via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Secondary button style lives in /app/frontend/public/css/theme.css (.btn-navy) and tokens in /app/frontend/public/css/tokens.css. Expected computed values for .btn-navy: bg rgb(237,240,255), border rgb(196,205,255), color rgb(59,35,168). Key testids for regressions: nav-demo-btn, nav-free-trial-btn, trial-card-esignature/-dms/-bulksigner, pricing-tab-esignature/-dms/-bulksigner, esign-billing-switch, bulk-licence-input, bulk-estimate-plan/-total.
rca of the issue: Not a bug — requested color change verified working.
